card.name: Polite address words opening a new sentence
card.fires_on: Words that start or sit at a sentence break and address the reader, such as Please, please, Welcome, your, and section headings like Procedure. Seen in web pages and patient-information text.

modes.label: Please / Welcome
modes.description: A polite address to the reader at the start of a sentence or after a clause.
modes.example: renal venogram.<< Please>> see these procedures for additional information.

modes.label: Heading and punctuation breaks
modes.description: Heading words or punctuation right where a new section or sentence begins.
modes.example: Risks<< of>> the Procedure The amount of radiation used

modes.label: Reader-directed phrasing
modes.description: Words like your or shall in direct statements to the reader.
modes.example: Tamper Evident: S ealed for<< your>> protection.
